outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication (home language): pre-literacy
outcomes.outcome: Associates the letters of the home-language alphabet with their sounds, starting with the vowels.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication (home language): pre-literacy
outcomes.outcome: Blends letters into syllables and reads simple, familiar home-language words.
Hears and distinguishes individual sounds in spoken words, including sounds that differ between the home language and English.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
outcomes.outcome: Recognises English letters and associates them with their most common sounds.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
outcomes.outcome: Decodes and understands simple, regularly spelt English words, including words not seen before.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
outcomes.outcome: Recognises common high-frequency English words that are not spelt by regular sound rules.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
outcomes.outcome: Forms lower-case letters correctly and writes or types simple words.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
outcomes.outcome: Listens to and understands simple spoken English words and sentences about familiar topics.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
outcomes.outcome: Reads and understands short, simple English sentences about familiar situations.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
outcomes.outcome: Builds short, simple English sentences in the correct word order.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
outcomes.outcome: Reads simple functional texts (SMS messages, signs, notices) and finds key information such as who, what, when and where.

outcomes.learningArea: Language, Literacy and Communication: English (additional language)
outcomes.outcome: Writes or types short functional responses, such as a reply to a message or a short answer.
